questions.stemHtml: A 78-year-old woman with hypertension presents with a weakness of left upper and lower limbs suggestive of hemiparesis. Cardiac monitoring reveals the finding as shown in the figure. Heart rate is 160/min, irregular. BP is 130/80.Lungs are clear on auscultation. Along with rate control, which of the following is appropriate management?

options.label: D
options.text: Warfarin with a target INR of 2.0 to 3.0
